explanation: A prophet in the Old Testament who received visions and messages from God.
A title used for God, often to show respect and reverence.
The name of the biblical people whom God chose as his special people, as well as the land where they lived.
False gods or objects that people worship instead of the true God.
An ancient empire in Mesopotamia, known for its power and splendor. The Israelites were taken captive there during the Babylonian exile.
God's act of saving people from sin and its consequences.
God's righteous evaluation of human actions and their consequences.
An agreement between God and his people, often involving promises and obligations from both sides.
A message or revelation from God, delivered through a prophet.
The seventh day of the week, which God commanded the Israelites to keep holy as a day of rest and as a sign of their covenant with him.
